title: London 1665 Listed 2,614 Deaths Under "Teeth" #Shorts
description:
In 1665 London's official Bill of Mortality listed plague, fever, consumption... and 2,614 deaths under one short word: "Teeth". Many were probably babies who died while teething, and the causes were decided by untrained searchers. But a rotten tooth could also kill in days.

Full video: https://youtu.be/p2DssmoAlBY
